You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From ff6f3aff46beb3c29e0802cffcc559e1756c4814 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Qii Wang <qii.wang@mediatek.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2020 19:55:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] i2c: mediatek: Fix generic definitions for bus frequency

The max frequency of mediatek i2c controller driver is
I2C_MAX_HIGH_SPEED_MODE_FREQ, not I2C_MAX_FAST_MODE_PLUS_FREQ.
Fix it.

Fixes: 90224e6468e1 ("i2c: drivers: Use generic definitions for bus frequencies")
Reviewed-by: Yingjoe Chen <yingjoe.chen@mediatek.com>
Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andy.shevchenko@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Qii Wang <qii.wang@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Wolfram Sang <wsa@kernel.org>
---
 drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-mt65xx.c | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-mt65xx.c b/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-mt65xx.c
index efc14041d45b..a1978ebd8177 100644
--- a/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-mt65xx.c
+++ b/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-mt65xx.c
@@ -681,8 +681,8 @@ static int mtk_i2c_calculate_speed(struct mtk_i2c *i2c, unsigned int clk_src,
 	unsigned int cnt_mul;
 	int ret = -EINVAL;
 
-	if (target_speed > I2C_MAX_FAST_MODE_PLUS_FREQ)
-		target_speed = I2C_MAX_FAST_MODE_PLUS_FREQ;
+	if (target_speed > I2C_MAX_HIGH_SPEED_MODE_FREQ)
+		target_speed = I2C_MAX_HIGH_SPEED_MODE_FREQ;
 
 	max_step_cnt = mtk_i2c_max_step_cnt(target_speed);
 	base_step_cnt = max_step_cnt;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrectly using the maximum frequency definition for the Mediatek I2C controller driver. The code was limiting the target speed to `I2C_MAX_FAST_MODE_PLUS_FREQ` instead of the correct maximum frequency, which is `I2C_MAX_HIGH_SPEED_MODE_FREQ`. This led to potential misconfigurations of the I2C bus frequency, preventing the driver from utilizing the full capabilities of the hardware.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly using the maximum frequency definition for the Mediatek I2C controller driver. The code was limiting the target speed to `I2C_MAX_FAST_MODE_PLUS_FREQ` instead of the correct maximum frequency, which is `I2C_MAX_HIGH_SPEED_MODE_FREQ`. This led to potential misconfigurations of the I2C bus frequency, preventing the driver from utilizing the full capabilities of the hardware.
